decision: D1 BLEND REPAIR (ruled): today's [15,24] = OSU EC1307's matted-row lo ('about 15 inches') + the regions' 18-24 hi. umn_ext 'Growing strawberries in the home garden': "the most common method is the matted row system: Space plants 18 to 24 inches apart." -> in_row [18,24]; "Space rows 3 to 4 feet apart." -> rows [36,48]. The same page's Quick facts line ('Space plants 12 to 18 inches apart') carries no system or row figure; the matted-row sentence is the default the crop describes. Corroborating matted-row 18-24: USU, UMD, UADA FSA6103. OSU EC1307 (15 in) is unfetchable (open finding strawberry_step11_unfetchable_osu_ec1307). Restatements: growth_stages[0] '15 inches' -> '18 to 24 inches'; the region notes keep their attributed regional figures (inside the authored range) and the UC two-row bed notes describe a different layout.

edits.new: Plant your strawberry crowns or small potted plants, setting each so the middle of the crown sits right at soil height. In a wide row, leave about 18 to 24 inches between plants.
edits.reason: PLA-10 R3 + D1: follows the authored in_row [18,24] (UMN matted row)

edits.new: Set dormant bare-root crowns or potted plugs in the planting window, crown midpoint level with the soil surface. In matted rows, space plants 18 to 24 inches apart in rows 3 to 4 feet apart.
edits.reason: PLA-10 R3 + D1: follows the authored in_row [18,24] / rows [36,48] (UMN matted row)

edits.new: Set dormant bare-root crowns about two weeks before the last spring frost, as soon as the soil can be worked. The plants are dormant, so there is no need to wait until frost danger has passed (USU). Plant so the middle of the crown sits level with the soil surface. In matted rows, space plants 18 to 24 inches apart in rows 3 to 4 feet apart (UMN).
edits.reason: PLA-10 (ruled 2026-10-01): re-attributed to the page the entry cites; OSU EC1307 is unfetchable (open finding) and its matted-row figure is about 15 in, so it cannot carry 18-24
